name: Heikin-Ashi Shaven-Bottom Streak
note: Trades the GEOMETRY of a transformed candle rather than a level: a run of green Heikin-Ashi candles with no lower shadow -- meaning the raw low never traded below the previous HA candle's midpoint -- and an above-average body. Mirrored shaven-top for shorts. Exits on the first HA candle that either turns against the position or grows a shadow larger than shadow_ratio of its own body. HA_close uses the current close, so every signal is a bar-close signal only.
source: Heikin-Ashi construction is standard; for its systematic use and noise-reduction properties see 'Smoothed Heikin-Ashi Algorithms Optimized for Automated Trading Systems' (2018), DOI 10.31410/itema.2018.514, and 'Study of Heiken Ashi Candlestick for Noise Reduction' (2022), DOI 10.31730/osf.io/phejd. The shaven-bottom streak rule and the shadow-reappearance exit are the harvester's synthesis.

def family_init(ctx):
    b = ctx.bars
    n = len(b)
    ho = [0.0] * n
    hc = [0.0] * n
    hh = [0.0] * n
    hl = [0.0] * n
    body = [0.0] * n
    prev_o = None
    prev_c = None
    for j in range(n):
        o = float(b[j]["o"])
        h = float(b[j]["h"])
        l = float(b[j]["l"])
        c = float(b[j]["c"])
        cc = (o + h + l + c) / 4.0
        oo = (o + c) / 2.0 if prev_o is None else (prev_o + prev_c) / 2.0
        ho[j] = oo
        hc[j] = cc
        hh[j] = max(h, oo, cc)
        hl[j] = min(l, oo, cc)
        body[j] = abs(cc - oo)
        prev_o = oo
        prev_c = cc
    w = max(1, int(ctx.p.body_win))
    mb = [None] * n
    run = 0.0
    for j in range(n):
        run += body[j]
        if j >= w:
            run -= body[j - w]
        if j >= w - 1:
            mb[j] = run / w
    ctx.ho = ctx.series(ho, "ha_open")
    ctx.hc = ctx.series(hc, "ha_close")
    ctx.hh = ctx.series(hh, "ha_high")
    ctx.hl = ctx.series(hl, "ha_low")
    ctx.body = ctx.series(body, "ha_body")
    ctx.mbody = ctx.series(mb, "ha_body_mean")


def signal(ctx, i):
    k = int(ctx.p.streak)
    if k < 1 or i < k:
        return 0
    mb = ctx.mbody[i]
    if mb is None or mb <= 0:
        return 0
    if ctx.body[i] <= float(ctx.p.body_mult) * mb:
        return 0
    tol = float(ctx.p.tol_ticks) * float(ctx.p.tick)
    up = True
    dn = True
    for j in range(i - k + 1, i + 1):
        o = ctx.ho[j]
        c = ctx.hc[j]
        hi = ctx.hh[j]
        lo = ctx.hl[j]
        if c <= o or (o - lo) > tol:
            up = False
        if c >= o or (hi - o) > tol:
            dn = False
        if not up and not dn:
            return 0
    if up:
        return 1
    if dn:
        return -1
    return 0


def exit_signal(ctx, i):
    if not ctx.positions:
        return False
    o = ctx.ho[i]
    c = ctx.hc[i]
    hi = ctx.hh[i]
    lo = ctx.hl[i]
    if o is None or c is None:
        return False
    bd = abs(c - o)
    ratio = float(ctx.p.shadow_ratio)
    if ctx.positions[0]["side"] == "long":
        if c < o:
            return True
        return bd > 0 and (o - lo) > ratio * bd
    if c > o:
        return True
    return bd > 0 and (hi - o) > ratio * bd
